# Default-flag flips expose previously opt-in code paths (P0)

Pattern: flipping a config default (e.g. DETAILED_REPORT False -> True) turns an opt-in branch into the default path. Edge cases that were only reachable via an explicit override (here: `stats.summarize(values, detailed=True)` dividing by `len(values)` with no empty-input guard -> ZeroDivisionError on `report([])`) become default-path crashes. The test suite stayed green because the existing empty-input test pinned `detailed=False` explicitly and the default/detailed tests only used populated input.

Review heuristic: when a diff changes a default, enumerate the existing tests that pin the *old* value explicitly, and check the newly-defaulted branch against every documented edge case (empty input, zero, None). Require default-path tests for those edge cases in the same change.
